headline.purpose: Result card drug name — the only serif use inside the working app.

body.purpose: All prose, form labels, buttons, inputs — the type floor for anything read as language.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow labels, tabs-group section headers.

numeral.purpose: The calculated dose figure — monospace, tabular-nums, the largest element on the result screen.

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Resting state of interactive cards (drug card, active tab).

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Hover state of interactive cards, primary button hover.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: The result card at rest — the one surface allowed to look lifted by default.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Shared focus-visible treatment used everywhere in place of a native outline.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered fade-and-rise (translateY 12px → 0), landing/about pages only. Never used on the calculator, catalog, or history screens.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus/active transition for buttons, inputs, tabs, chips.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Drug card hover lift (translateY(-1px)) and category-tint fade-in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width solid near-black CTA button, e.g. "Hitung" (Calculate).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; text-align: center; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #fff; border-color: #111111; width: 100%; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(40,35,28,.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(40,35,28,.03); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333333; border-color: #333333; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(40,35,28,.04), 0 1px 3px rgba(40,35,28,.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1f6c9f; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Blue-on-white outlined button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1f6c9f; border-color: #b9e0f8; padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e1f3fe; border-color: #1f6c9f; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1f6c9f; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field used for weight, dose/kg, frequency, and search inputs.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 1rem; border: 1.5px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1f6c9f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1f6c9f; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #75716b; }

components.name: Drug Card
components.description: The preset-picker's core unit: a category-colored card representing one drug in the 92-drug catalog grid.
components.css: .ds-drug-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 3px; padding: 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #eaeaea; border-left: 3px solid var(--ds-cat, #948e81); border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s, border-color .12s, background .12s; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,35,28,.03); cursor: pointer; width: 100%; } .ds-drug-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f) 9%, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(40,35,28,.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(40,35,28,.03); } .ds-drug-card:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1f6c9f; } .ds-drug-card__name { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-drug-card__route { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #75716b; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: The calculated-dose output card — the destination of the whole app flow, the one surface with a shadow lift and the serif drug-name heading.
components.html:
Paracetamol
Per Dosis120mg
components.css: .ds-result-card { margin-top: 20px; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 16px 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(40,35,28,.045), 0 2px 6px rgba(40,35,28,.03); } .ds-result-card__drug { font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-result-value { background: #f7f6f3; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-result-value--highlight { background: #e1f3fe; border-color: #b9e0f8; } .ds-result-value__label { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #75716b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-result-value__num { font-size: 2.375rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1f6c9f; letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; } .ds-result-value__unit { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #75716b; font-weight: 500; margin-left: 4px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped category filter chip above the drug grid; active state uses a category-tinted background, never a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-cat-chip { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #eaeaea; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; transition: background .12s, border-color .12s, color .12s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cat-chip:hover { border-color: #948e81; color: #111111; } .ds-cat-chip--active { color: var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f) 12%, #ffffff); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-cat, #1f6c9f) 45%, #ffffff); } .ds-cat-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1f6c9f; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: The Preset / Kustom / Puyer / Infus segmented control that switches calculator modes.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #eaeaea; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab-btn { flex: 1; padding: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #57534e; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 5px; transition: background .15s, color .15s, box-shadow .15s; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-btn:hover:not(.ds-tab-btn--active) { background: rgba(255,255,255,.5); color: #111111; } .ds-tab-btn--active { background: #ffffff; color: #1f6c9f; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,35,28,.03); }

components.name: Safety Disclaimer
components.description: The hard-requirement clinical disclaimer banner shown near every dose decision; never a tooltip, modal, or toast.
components.html: Alat bantu hitung, bukan alat diagnosis. Verifikasi dosis terhadap pedoman klinis institusi Anda sebelum digunakan.
components.css: .ds-safety-banner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 0 20px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-left: 3px solid #8a5a00; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #57534e; } .ds-safety-banner__icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1.2em; height: 1.2em; margin-top: .15em; color: #8a5a00; } .ds-safety-banner strong { color: #111111; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
DoseRx reads like a well-kept clinical reference book, not a SaaS dashboard: warm paper-white surfaces, a near-black ink color for text, one restrained blue for interactive meaning, and a serif reserved for the moments the app is naming something (a drug, a page title) rather than asking for input. The system is built for a doctor's hand at 2am and a doctor's eye during a 3.5-second glance — every choice trades decoration for scan speed, and every number a clinician reads under time pressure gets its own typeface (monospace, tabular) so digits never shift or misalign.

The palette is deliberately narrow: exactly four semantic pastel pairs (primary/blue, warn/yellow, error/red, success/green), each a WCAG-verified text-on-background pair rather than a raw hue, plus one documented second accent (clay/tan) that exists for a single real clinical distinction — marking a solid preparation (tablet/powder) apart from a liquid dose shown elsewhere on the same screen. The one exception to "four pastels only" is the 17-color category-accent map used across the 92-drug catalog: each hue is a desaturated, darkened pass calibrated so the grid stays visually triaged without reading as a rainbow SaaS palette, with the loudest red reserved for true emergencies.

Motion is almost entirely absent from the working screens on purpose. The calculator, catalog, and history views are dense forms a clinician revisits repeatedly under time pressure — motion on every view there is friction, not sophistication. The one motion pattern in the system, a scroll-triggered fade-and-rise, is scoped to the landing/about pages only, where a first-time visitor is reading rather than working.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone neutrals (never cool gray, never pure black/white) as the entire structural palette
One accent hue doing real interactive work (links, focus, the CTA-adjacent primary role) plus one documented clay secondary for a real clinical distinction — no decorative color
Serif for naming (titles, drug names), sans for asking (UI chrome, forms, buttons), monospace+tabular-nums for every clinician-read number
Crisp, capped corner radii (4-12px); pills reserved for chips, tags, and segmented controls only
Near-zero motion on task screens; a single quiet scroll-reveal reserved for editorial/landing content
System font stacks only — no webfont dependency, by requirement (the app must render fully offline from a cold load)

rules.name: The Four Pastels Rule
rules.body: Outside the category-accent map, the palette carries exactly four semantic hues (primary, warn, error, success) plus one documented clay secondary. A new UI state does not get a new color; it's expressed with an existing semantic hue, weight, or icon.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Category and semantic colors are applied as a tinted background + colored text/border, never as a solid saturated fill with white text.

rules.name: The Read-vs-Non-Read Rule
rules.body: Anything a person reads (prose, values, form controls, buttons, drug names) sits at 16px or larger. Sub-16px sizes are reserved for non-prose only: uppercase eyebrows, unit suffixes, count badges, chips.

rules.name: The Three-Family Rule
rules.body: Sans for asking (UI chrome), serif for naming (titles, drug names), monospace for measuring (every clinician-read number). A component never borrows a family outside its job.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A component reaches for a 1-1.5px border first; a shadow is added only when a surface needs to read as physically raised above its neighbors (the result card, hover states).

dos: Do keep the interactive accent to one hue (clinical blue) outside the category-accent map and the one documented clay secondary.
Do use the monospace/tabular-nums family for every number a clinician reads mid-task (doses, mL, weights, timestamps).
Do express category identity through the shared data-cat color map and the color-mix() tint mechanism, never a hardcoded hex per component.
Do keep interactive targets at a 24px floor even for controls that sit inline with text.
Do render the safety disclaimer inline and visible near any dose output — never in a tooltip, modal, or toast.
Do reach for a border before a shadow; reserve shadow for a surface that genuinely needs to look physically lifted (the result card, hover states).
donts: Don't use a solid saturated color fill with white text for a category, tab, or status — tint the background and color the text/border instead.
Don't apply the landing page's scroll-reveal fade to the calculator, catalog, or history screens — those are dense working forms revisited under time pressure, where motion is friction.
Don't load a webfont or CDN font asset; the app must render fully offline from a cold first load, and the three system stacks already cover every typographic job.
Don't reuse the primary blue for a drug category color — blue is reserved for the app's single interactive-accent meaning.
Don't let pure black (#000) or pure white/cool-gray neutrals creep in; every neutral in the system is warm-tinted (stone/paper), including shadows (never a cool slate-black).
